about: Targets minutes@vN must reach on minutes_golden.json: decision_recall (expected decisions found with the right status), item_recall (open items found with the right owner), question_recall, promise_recall (each person's promises in their personal minutes), shared_promise_free (no promise on any shared minutes; must be 1.0) and leak_free (no forbidden never-record text anywhere; must be 1.0). Not yet measured: the first live run (EVAL_LIVE=1, about 10 Sonnet calls) fills in the measured_* fields and sets measured.
